Button

Generated from code 11 hierarchies × 5 sizes · real component CSS

Rendered with the component’s own exported stylesheet and the exact host classes Angular applies, so every sample below is pixel-identical to the running app.

Usage

Every button in the platform is the ccaButton attribute component, applied to a native <button> or <a>. Material button directives are not part of the design system.

template
<!-- default: 48px tall, hierarchy="primary" --> <button ccaButton>Create shipment</button> <!-- explicit hierarchy and size --> <button ccaButton hierarchy="secondary" size="small">Cancel</button> <!-- icon-only needs an accessible name --> <button ccaButton hierarchy="icon" [iconOnly]="true" aria-label="Edit"> <cca-icon icon="pencil" /> </button> <!-- a link that looks like a button --> <a ccaButton hierarchy="primary" [routerLink]="['/trips']">View trips</a>

Hierarchy

11 hierarchies. Only one primary per view — if a screen seems to need two, one of them is a secondary.

hierarchy="primary" — Primary
hierarchy="secondary" — Secondary
hierarchy="subtle" — Subtle
hierarchy="tertiary" — Tertiary
hierarchy="link" — Link
hierarchy="danger-primary" — Danger Primary
hierarchy="danger-secondary" — Danger Secondary
hierarchy="danger-text" — Danger Text
hierarchy="warning-primary" — Warning Primary
hierarchy="warning-secondary" — Warning Secondary
hierarchy="icon" — Icon

Size

Five sizes: x-small 2rem, small 2.25rem, default 3rem, large 3.5rem, x-large 4rem. size="default" adds no class — the base rule is the 48px default, which is why it matches a form field exactly.

size="x-small" — height 2rem · padding 0 0.5rem · font-size 0.875rem
size="small" — height 2.25rem · padding 0 0.5rem · font-size 0.875rem
size="default" (default) — height 3rem · padding 0 0.75rem · font-size 1rem
size="large" — height 3.5rem · padding 0 1rem · font-size 1rem
size="x-large" — height 4rem · padding 0 1.25rem · font-size 1rem

Icon only

The square variants drop the fixed height and derive their size from padding plus icon instead. Bordered hierarchies land 2px larger; tertiary and danger-text have no border, so they hit the exact numbers.

iconOnly · size="x-small" — padding 0.5rem
iconOnly · size="small" — padding 0.5rem
iconOnly · size="default" — padding 0.75rem
iconOnly · size="large" — padding 1rem
iconOnly · size="x-large" — padding 1.25rem

An icon-only button still needs a name

There is no visible label for a screen reader to read, so every icon-only button needs an aria-label.

Legacy classes — do not use

These global helpers silently override the size input

.button-small, .button-square, .small-icon-button, .icon-button-small, .xsmall-icon-button, .icon-button-rounded, .icon-button-extra-small are Material-era global classes that still live in shared/styles/components/_button.scss. They set sizing with !important, so anywhere one is still layered onto a ccaButton it wins over that button’s own size. Use size and iconOnly instead.
